## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND and VIX/VXX flat-to-falling (VXX (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -4.79%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) versus mixed cyclicals/tech readings produce a neutral, two‑way market.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit signals mixed but stable: HYG (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY and LQD (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY imply neutral HYG/LQD. Fear is easing short term as VXX (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -4.79%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND, but broader risk ratios remain flat → neutral.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: TLT (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.82%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND signals higher yields while SPY_TLT is reported NEUTRAL, keeping financial conditions balanced.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and financials leading: XLF (Financials) (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND and XLY (Consumer Disc.) (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND; Tech mixed-to-weak with XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) BELOW TREND and sector Tech (1W: +2.45% | 1M: -2.59%) RECOVERY — style: Value/Cyclicals favored over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
China/EM leadership versus US: FXI (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND and KWEB (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +13.42%) ABOVE TREND, while SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND but trailing China on 1M; EEM (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -3.60%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: ETHA (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND shows crypto risk appetite, IBIT (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +4.82%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -12.96%) BELOW TREND show selective speculative flow.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodities bifurcated: CPER (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +6.32%) ABOVE TREND and broad raw materials strength on 1M, while short‑term pullbacks in oil (BNO (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%) CORRECTION) signal profit taking.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed but constructive on month: XLE (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +12.76%) CORRECTION with USO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: +25.08%) CORRECTION, while nat‑gas UNG (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -12.67%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND and sector breadth (7/11) confirm underlying tape; confirmed cyclicals: XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) BELOW TREND vs sector Tech RECOVERY is a MINOR divergence to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to cyclicals/financials and commodity beta given XLF and CPER ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to areas showing sustained weakness like XLK and ARKK; bonds (TLT (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND) to be monitored, neutral stance.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +6.32%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) BELOW TREND, XBI (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%) CORRECTION — watch for resumption; CPER ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -12.67%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD spread and HYG/LQD ratio (watch ~0.80 for credit health); XLK/XLF relative move around 1.0 (monitor growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive with mixed risk ratios and SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND supporting a balanced market. Financials and cyclicals showing relative strength — XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND and XLY (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND. Key divergence to monitor: Tech weakness (XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) BELOW TREND) versus rising commodity/China exposure.
